info.description: A single case study card to display on the Products page

tag.description: Text tag (e.g., 'Leading telco provider'). Shown if no Logo is provided.

context.description: The context text shown below the oversized stat.

image.description: Thumbnail shown at ~380×220, cover. Recommended: 760×440 px WebP/JPG.

cta_label.description: Label for the CTA link (e.g., 'Read Full Study'). Defaults to 'Read Full Study' if left blank.

cta_href.description: The URL to redirect to when the user clicks the case study card.
